description: Get the status-transition timeline of a single Canton Improvement Proposal (CIP): each dated from->to change (e.g. Draft->Review->Final). Use for 'how/when did CIP-X move through governance' questions. Returns history only, not the proposal body (get_cip) or vote tallies (get_cip_votes). Canton ecosystem only. Not Cardano or other 'CIP' schemes.
name: get_cip_history
